mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sso_secret_sync (app_id, app_secret, app_secret_old, update_time, create_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{appSecret}, #{appSecretOld}, #{updateTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_id AS appId, app_secret AS appSecret, app_secret_old AS appSecretOld, update_time AS updateTime, create_time AS createTime FROM sso_secret_sync ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
